text: A psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. [1] [AA]
I How many are my foes, Lord!How many rise against me!
t[2]How many say of me,"There is no salvation for him in God." [AB]Selah
But you, Lord, are a shield around me;my glory, you keep my head high. [AC]
II With my own voice I will call out to the Lord,and he will answer me from his holy mountain.Selah
I lie down and I fall asleep,[and] I will wake up, for the Lord sustains me. [AD]
I do not fear, then, thousands of peoplearrayed against me on every side.
III Arise, Lord! Save me, my God!For you strike the cheekbone of all my foes;you break the teeth of the wicked. [AE]
Salvation is from the Lord!May your blessing be upon your people! [AF]Selah
